subject: Approval requested: Director of ML (FinRise) — OOB comp + sign-on
messages:
From: Kira Lopez <kira.lopez@talentsmith.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Jordan Price — Dir. ML systems (FinRise) — request to approve OOB comp package

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note — FinRise moved fast and Jordan Price (ex-Scale, led model infra at Cleo) just accepted; they want us to expedite. Jordan has a counter from a competitor and is asking for an out-of-band package. Hiring team recommends we approve to close. Summary below and I attached the candidate resume and a finance sketch: offer_finance_breakdown.pdf, candidate_resume.pdf.

Role: Director, ML Systems (IC/manager blended) — reports to Marissa Cole (hiring manager)
Base band (level): L8 band midpoint: $190,000–$220,000 base
Proposed package (requested):
- Base: $240,000 (above band — outlier request)
- Target ONT (total cash + equity realized): ~ $360k ARR equivalent
- Equity: 0.38% RSU with a 25% refresh at year 2 (equity refresh requested due to competing offer)
- Sign-on: $30,000 one-time (requested to offset counter and relocation)
- Relocation assistance: standard

Why exception: Jordan’s experience is narrow/rare for our infra roadmap (heavy optimization for low-latency KV cache across GPU clusters). Marissa confirms this maps to a high-impact role for Q3 launches and would materially shorten time to ship core batching improvements. Candidate is asking for a decision and DocuSign link; recruiter has tentative verbal acceptance pending approvals.

Requested asks from you:
1) Approve out-of-band base to $240k (L8 outlier)
2) Approve equity refresh clause (25% at year 2)
3) Approve $30k sign-on (can be clawed over 12 months if voluntary departure)

If you want, I can loop in Finance (Laura) and Comp (Rishi) for numbers/chargecode. DocuSign preview: https://docusign.net/FinRise/JPrice-offer

Thanks,
Kira

--
Kira Lopez
Senior Recruiter, TalentSmith (partner)

Subject: Re: Candidate Jordan Price — Dir. ML systems (FinRise) — request to approve OOB comp package

Evelyn —

Following up on Kira's note. I’ve worked closely with Jordan over the interview loop; he’s a clear comp market outlier and brings immediate architecture-level impact on our inference runtime (KV cache eviction heuristics + multi-GPU attention optimizations). He will own the Q3 performance milestones tied to the batching/caching roadmap.

A few operational notes for Finance/Comp:
- Headcount: open, we have an approved FTE for Q3 under ENG-ML-2026 (chargecode ENG-ML-2026-07).
- Budget: I’ve modeled the first-year cash impact in offer_finance_breakdown.pdf (attached). We can absorb the sign-on into hiring OPEX if approved.
- Ramp & retention: I support a 12-month clawback on the sign-on and a 2-year vesting slip for the refresh clause to guarantee retention.

Marissa’s recommendation: Approve all three items (base, equity refresh, sign-on) given candidate fit and time sensitivity. If helpful, I can jump on a 15-min call to walk through the tech impact.

Thanks,
Marissa

--

Director, Inference Platform

Subject: Re: Candidate Jordan Price — Dir. ML systems (FinRise) — request to approve OOB comp package

Team —

Thanks for the context. A couple of quick finance checks before I sign off:
1) Cost amortization: For the sign-on, we prefer to amortize $30k over 12 months for internal cap purposes; please confirm if hiring wants it expensed up-front or amortized.
2) Equity refresh: We need a short rationale memo for the refresh clause (we treat refreshes conservatively on the P&L). Could you add 2–3 bullets on why this candidate warrants a year-2 refresh vs. standard grant?
3) Chargecode: Confirm ENG-ML-2026-07 is the final chargecode — if not, provide the exact GL.

If those three items are OK, Finance can approve the incremental spend. I’ve attached an annotated version of offer_finance_breakdown.pdf with a small note (attachment: offer_finance_breakdown.pdf — annotated).

One more ask: For compliance, add a clause to DocuSign specifying the sign-on clawback conditions (we usually use standard HR wording). I can provide the template.

—Laura

Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kira Lopez <kira.lopez@talentsmith.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@finrise.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Candidate Jordan Price — Dir. ML systems (FinRise) — request to approve OOB comp package

All —

Thank you — I’ve reviewed Marissa’s recommendation and Laura’s notes. Approvals below with conditions:

1) Out-of-band base to $240,000 — APPROVED (one-time exception given immediate roadmap impact).
2) Equity: Approve 0.38% RSU with the requested 25% year-2 refresh — APPROVED conditional on a two-bullet justification (tech scarcity + measurable Q3 milestone ownership) to be added to the HR packet.
3) Sign-on: $30,000 — APPROVED with clawback (12-month prorated repayment on voluntary departure) and amortization across 12 months for internal reporting.

Conditions/ops items (please action before sending official offer via DocuSign):
- Marissa: add the two-bullet justification for the refresh to the HR cover memo.
- Laura: please attach the annotated finance breakdown and provide the final GL/chargecode confirmation (ENG-ML-2026-07 ok?) and sign-off line for payroll.
- Rishi/People Ops: include HR sign-on clawback language and the 2-year refresh vesting schedule in the offer.

Marissa, once the items above are updated, please proceed to send the DocuSign link and get candidate signature. Kira, please confirm the candidate timeline — if Jordan will hold the counter only 48 hours, push the DocuSign immediately after Laura’s GL confirmation.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
VP, Talent & People Operations
evelyn_hart@redwood.inference.com
